title: Add a limit to the product list
description: The storefront's new-arrivals strip only needs a few products. GET /api/products takes an optional `limit` and then returns only the newest `limit` products; without it, it still returns them all. Includes tests and a README update.

comments.issue: `limit` is passed to Prisma without checking it is a positive whole number: `?limit=-1` returns the oldest products, and `?limit=abc` gives NaN, which makes Prisma throw, so the route answers 500 instead of 400.
